Mobile app · React Native

IRIS — private messaging

A messaging app built around one idea: your conversations stay yours. IRIS pairs a WhatsApp-familiar chat experience with end-to-end encryption done properly — keys are generated on the device and never leave it.

  • End-to-end encrypted one-to-one and group chats, with media sharing
  • Push notifications routed through a Cloudflare Worker relay with Firebase Cloud Messaging
  • Real users, real feedback — actively tested, with bugs reported and fixed release over release
React Native Firebase / Firestore Cloudflare Workers FCM E2E encryption

Visitly
Every shop visit, planned and remembered.

Web app · PWA + Android

Visitly — retailer visit tracker

Built for people who visit shops for a living. Visitly keeps a retailer's rounds in one place — who to visit, when, and what happened last time — and reminds you before a visit is due, even with the app closed.

  • Works offline — visits are stored on-device in IndexedDB, no account needed
  • Reminders that land — a nudge the day before each visit, at 7 PM by default
  • One codebase, two forms — installable PWA, packaged as an Android app with Capacitor
PWA IndexedDB Capacitor Android Notifications
